limitations: Cold/hot are separate processes without forced OS cache clearing; no persistent in-memory cache is implied.
Reported speed changes are observed wall time; machine load is not controlled by this script.
Scale 0.5 and native acceptance rejection remain diagnostic-only; MTF/boundary N/A is not a pass.
Fusion phase log durations are rounded; report counters should be checked when available.
Semantic report and JPEG equality support regression checks, not a complete full-resolution per-pixel proof.
Artifacts were generated in preview-only mode; JPEG equality is not a full native TIFF pixel comparison.
